# UX Checklist: Monitoring Configuration Wizard Flow Consolidation

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, and consistency of wizard-flow requirements
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all five wizard steps explicitly ordered for both create and edit flows? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001-FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the create-mode in-memory General draft and exact point at which a configuration is created unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, FR-012]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all responsibilities assigned to exactly one owning step, including GitLab URL and Scheduling? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003-FR-008, FR-018-FR-019]
- [ ] CHK004 Are list, detail, Enable/Disable, and Delete action locations consistently defined? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014-FR-016]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is each Previous, Next, first-step, and final-step behavior explicitly specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009-FR-010]
- [ ] CHK006 Does the create flow clearly distinguish non-persisting candidate validation, configuration creation, secure credential save, and retry? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, FR-024]
- [ ] CHK007 Are stepper interactivity and the single navigation mechanism clearly defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, FR-009-FR-011]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the outcomes of validation failure, create failure, and post-create credential-save failure specified without implying duplicate configuration creation? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Do save-before-advance requirements align with create-mode General staging and existing per-step save behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012-FR-013]
- [ ] CHK010 Are Enable/Disable and Delete placement rules consistent across requirements, scenarios, and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014-FR-016, SC-003]
- [ ] CHK011 Are preservation requirements for Features 004, 005, 009, and 014 consistent with the new navigation shell? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006-FR-008, FR-020]

## Non-Functional and Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK012 Are credential privacy and the no-persistence boundary for candidate validation specific enough to prevent secret exposure? [Security, Spec §FR-004, FR-024]
- [ ] CHK013 Are keyboard access, active-step semantics, focus visibility, fixed-bar overlap, and narrow-width behavior all covered? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, FR-011, FR-021-FR-022]
- [ ] CHK014 Are unsaved-change behaviors defined for forward, backward, and leaving the wizard, including the transient create draft? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012-FR-013]
- [ ] CHK015 Does the specification make visual references subordinate to functional requirements and identify their visual-only role? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `requirements.md` is the separate built-in spec-quality checklist maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
